framework: Original German course mapped to CEFR A1 communicative outcomes

sources.title: Goethe A1 practice materials: four skills

modules.title: First interactions
modules.outcome: Introduce yourself and exchange basic personal details with a patient speaker.

units.title: Greetings & introductions
units.canDo: Choose a greeting and say goodbye.

units.title: Origin, residence & languages
units.canDo: Say where you come from and where you live.

units.title: Numbers, spelling & personal details
units.canDo: Understand and give numbers from 0 to 100 in familiar contexts.

units.title: Module 1 checkpoint: meet a course partner
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.

modules.title: People, home & work
modules.outcome: Give simple information about people, a home and familiar work or study.

units.title: Family & people
units.canDo: Introduce close family members.

units.title: Home & possessions
units.canDo: Describe a home and name its main rooms.

units.title: Work, study & everyday places
units.canDo: Say what you do and where you work or study.

units.title: Module 2 checkpoint: a new neighbour
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.

modules.title: Daily life & plans
modules.outcome: Describe familiar activities and arrange a simple meeting using times and days.

units.title: Daily routine
units.canDo: Describe a simple sequence of daily activities.

units.title: Time, dates & appointments
units.canDo: Understand simple times, weekdays and dates.

units.title: Leisure, weather & simple plans
units.canDo: Say what you like doing and what you can do.

units.title: Module 3 checkpoint: arrange a weekend
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.

modules.title: Food, shopping & transactions
modules.outcome: Request familiar goods, understand quantities and prices, and complete a simple purchase.

units.title: Food, drink & a café order
units.canDo: Order a simple drink or snack politely.

units.title: Groceries, quantities & prices
units.canDo: Buy everyday food using simple quantities.

units.title: Clothes, preferences & requests
units.canDo: Ask for a simple item in a shop.

units.title: Module 4 checkpoint: shopping day
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.

modules.title: Travel, places & services
modules.outcome: Find a place, use basic transport information and ask for a simple service.

units.title: Around town & simple directions
units.canDo: Ask where a familiar place is.

units.title: Transport & travel information
units.canDo: Buy a simple train or bus ticket.

units.title: Accommodation & simple service problems
units.canDo: Check into a hotel using simple details.

units.title: Module 5 checkpoint: arrive in a new city
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.

modules.title: Needs, messages & consolidation
modules.outcome: Express a basic need, exchange short messages and combine familiar language across A1 situations.

units.title: Health, needs & asking for help
units.canDo: Say how you feel and name a simple symptom.

units.title: Short messages, invitations & forms
units.canDo: Understand a brief everyday message.

units.title: A short account & A1 consolidation
units.canDo: Give a very short account of a familiar experience using learned phrases.

units.title: A1 final checkpoint: everyday communication
units.canDo: Understand key details in short text and slow speech.
